display_name: Someshvara I of Kalyani vs Rajadhiraja Chola
one_line: Rival warrior-kings locked in the Chalukya–Chola struggle over Vengi and the Krishna-Godavari delta.

appearance.age_look: early 30s, tall and athletic, broad-shouldered with disciplined warrior’s build
appearance.face: oval face with medium-brown South Indian complexion; sharp nose, strong jaw, thin moustache and short trimmed beard; intense focused eyes with a calm, kingly default expression
appearance.hair: thick black hair tied back in a high warrior’s bun, wrapped with a narrow red cloth band; simple gold circlet-style crown with three small leaf-like points at the front, worn over the hair
appearance.costume: layered royal-warfare attire mixing Deccan and Tamil elements: an inner knee-length off-white cotton tunic with short sleeves; over it a fitted sleeveless maroon silk upper garment (angarkha-style) with simple gold trim at the edges; lower garment is a ankle-length dhoti-like wrapped cloth in deep indigo blue, pleated at the front and firmly tied at the waist; a broad golden-yellow sash circles the waist and knots on the left, ends hanging; over shoulders a diagonal rust-orange cotton-velvet mantle draped from right shoulder across the chest to left hip, hinting at a royal shawl but fitted for battle; forearms protected by plain bronze bracers; feet in brown leather sandals with sturdy straps; minimal but regal jewellery—small round gold earrings, a single medium-thick gold neck torque, and two simple gold armlets high on the biceps—keeping the look martial rather than ornate
appearance.signature: a long broad-bladed South Indian sword with a gently curving steel blade, plain iron crossguard, and a dark wooden hilt wrapped in red cloth, carried sheathed at his left hip in a brown leather scabbard with a small gold boss near the mouth

ref_desc: Someshvara I and Rajadhiraja are merged into one tall, athletic brown-skinned king with an oval face, warrior’s bun under a simple gold circlet, maroon upper garment, indigo dhoti, rust-orange mantle, golden-yellow sash, bronze bracers, and a red-hilted South Indian sword.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a single tall, athletic South Indian warrior-king: medium-brown oval face, sharp nose, trimmed moustache and short beard, intense eyes and calm regal expression; thick black hair tied in a high bun wrapped with a narrow red band and topped by a simple gold circlet with three small front points. He wears an off-white knee-length cotton tunic with short sleeves beneath a fitted sleeveless maroon silk upper garment edged in plain gold trim, an ankle-length indigo blue dhoti-style wrapped lower cloth pleated at the front, a broad golden-yellow waist sash knotted on the left with hanging ends, and a rust-orange mantle draped from right shoulder across his chest to the left hip. Show plain bronze bracers on his forearms, simple brown leather sandals, small round gold earrings, a single gold neck torque, and two understated gold armlets on his upper arms. At his left hip, include a long gently curving South Indian sword in a brown leather scabbard with a small gold boss, the hilt dark wood wrapped in red cloth. Use maroon, indigo, rust orange, golden yellow, and off-white as dominant colors, keeping the design dignified, era-grounded, and consistent from head to toe.
